judged_text: The rewritten .update context contains a single test that only exercises automatic group id 1, so the true branch of the new guard `group.name = params[:name] if params[:name] && !group.automatic` — renaming an ordinary group — has zero coverage, while the old 'is able to update group members' test that verified a normal-group rename was deleted in this same diff. A regression that stops persisting name (or visible/alias_level) for non-automatic groups passes CI; the sole update test asserts group 1's name is NOT 'WAT', which cannot detect a broken rename path for the groups admins actually edit.

adjudication.rationale: In spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb the new `context ".update"` only tests `id: 1` (an automatic group) and asserts the name does *not* change, so it never covers the non-automatic branch of `Admin::GroupsController#update` (`group.name = params[:name] if params[:name] && !group.automatic`). The diff also removes the prior update test that exercised renaming a normal group (and member updates), leaving ordinary-group rename persistence untested. This is a concrete, diff-grounded coverage gap rather than a proven runtime defect.
